typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ENDDATE as timestamp (),
	FileLocation as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	STARTDATE as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		CREATEDATE as timestamp,
		CLMSUBTYPE as string,
		AGPCLMNBR as string,
		RECEIVERID as string,
		SENDERNAME as string,
		VENDORNAME as string,
		INPUT_FILE_PATH as string,
		RECEIVERNAME as string,
		PATIENTACCOUNTNUMBER as string,
		SENDERID as string,
		TPCLMNUMBER as string,
		FILENAME as string,
		MEDICAID_MEDICARE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT  PATIENTACCOUNTNUMBER,     	[AGPCLMNBR]   , 	[TPCLMNUMBER] , 	[SENDERNAME]  , 	[SENDERID]    , 	[RECEIVERID]  , 	[RECEIVERNAME], 	[VENDORNAME]  , 	[CLMSUBTYPE]  , 	[MEDICAID_MEDICARE] , 	[CREATEDATE] , 	[FILENAME] , 	[INPUT_FILE_PATH]  FROM [dbo].[IHCS_CLAIMSLIST_FINAL]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		CREATEDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLMSUBTYPE as string,
		AGPCLMNBR as string,
		RECEIVERID as string,
		SENDERNAME as string,
		VENDORNAME as string,
		INPUT_FILE_PATH as string,
		RECEIVERNAME as string,
		PATIENTACCOUNTNUMBER as string,
		SENDERID as string,
		TPCLMNUMBER as string,
		FILENAME as string,
		MEDICAID_MEDICARE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CREATEDATE,
		CLMSUBTYPE,
		AGPCLMNBR,
		RECEIVERID,
		SENDERNAME,
		VENDORNAME,
		INPUT_FILE_PATH,
		RECEIVERNAME,
		PATIENTACCOUNTNUMBER,
		SENDERID,
		TPCLMNUMBER,
		FILENAME,
		MEDICAID_MEDICARE)) ~> FlatFileDestination
